meta.description: Complete user flow documentation for the Artha household economy PWA

flows.name: App startup — brand-new install (no family)
flows.trigger: User opens the PWA for the first time on a device with no family in the database

steps.description: React mounts App component. BrowserRouter and FamilyProvider wrap the tree.
FamilyProvider calls loadFamily() on mount. Fetches family, members, chores, rewards from Supabase. All return empty; sets loading=false.
DeviceGate reads localStorage('artha_device_claim') — null. Runs getDeviceClaim() + checkFamilyExists() in parallel.
checkFamilyExists() returns false. DeviceGate sets screen='onboarding'. Renders <Onboarding />.

edge_cases: Supabase unavailable: loadFamily() catches error, app still shows onboarding (DeviceGate catches error → sets screen='join')
Family row exists but no device claim: routes to JoinFamily instead of Onboarding
failure_points: VITE_SUPABASE_URL or VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY missing → all DB calls fail silently

flows.name: App startup — returning device with cached claim
flows.trigger: User opens the PWA on a device that has previously claimed a family membership

steps.description: DeviceGate calls readCachedClaim() synchronously — reads localStorage('artha_device_claim'). Returns claim object.
Claim found. DeviceGate sets screen='ready' immediately (no async check). DeviceContext.Provider wraps tree with claim value.
FamilyProvider loadFamily() runs in parallel — loads family data from Supabase.
AuthProvider mounts. Reads localStorage('artha_member_id'). If found, calls getMember() to restore session.
If no saved member ID: renders PinAuth. If member restored: navigates to /parent or /child/home based on role.

edge_cases: Cached claim JSON is corrupt: readCachedClaim() returns null, falls through to async check
Member ID in localStorage but member deleted from DB: getMember() returns null, session not restored, shows PinAuth
failure_points: localStorage cleared by browser: device must be reclaimed

flows.name: Family creation (Onboarding)
flows.trigger: First-time parent completes the 4-step onboarding wizard

steps.description: Parent fills in family name (step 0), selects role/avatar (step 1), enters name (step 2), sets and confirms 4-digit PIN (step 3).
On final step submit: hashPin(rawPin) called via Web Crypto SHA-256 with 'artha:' salt prefix.

createFamily({ familyName, memberName, avatar, pinHash }) called. Inserts families row (with FAMILY_ID constant and DEFAULT_CONFIG), then inserts first parent member row. Auto-claims this device as the founding parent device (upserts device_claims).
createFamily() returns { memberId, deviceId }. Onboarding calls onComplete(claim). DeviceGate saves claim to localStorage and sets screen='ready'. FamilyContext reloads.
App shows PinAuth. Parent selects their avatar and enters PIN to log in for the first time.

edge_cases: PIN confirmation mismatch: Onboarding shows error, does not submit
Supabase insert fails: error displayed inline, family row may be partially created. Seed checks member count > 0 before inserting, so retry is safe.
failure_points: FAMILY_ID hardcoded as 'dev-family-001' — second family creation would overwrite the first

flows.name: PIN login
flows.trigger: User selects their avatar on PinAuth and enters 4-digit PIN

steps.description: PinAuth mounts. If device claim has a memberId, useEffect auto-selects that member from the members list.
User selects avatar (or it's pre-selected). AvatarGrid renders all members filtered by device claim.
User enters 4 digits. On 4th digit: handleSubmit() fires automatically. Calls login(memberId, rawPin) from AuthContext.
login() fetches the member from Supabase via getMember(), then calls verifyPin(rawPin, member.pin). verifyPin re-hashes and compares.
PIN correct: login() sets currentMember in AuthContext state, writes member.id to localStorage('artha_member_id'). Returns true.
PinAuth calls navigate('/parent') for parents or navigate('/child/home') for children.
ParentShell or ChildShell renders. Checks currentMember.role — redirects to '/' if role mismatch.

edge_cases: Wrong PIN: login() returns false. PinAuth clears pin state, shows 'Wrong PIN' error.
Member not found (deleted after device claim): shows 'Member not found' error.
Device claimed to specific member: other members not shown in avatar grid
failure_points: Supabase offline during PIN verification: getMember() throws, login() catches and shows 'Something went wrong'

flows.name: Logout
flows.trigger: User taps the logout button (available in parent More screen or child settings)

steps.description: logout() called from AuthContext. Sets currentMember = null, removes localStorage('artha_member_id').
ParentShell or ChildShell detects currentMember is null, navigates to '/' (PinAuth).

flows.name: New device claims family via invite code
flows.trigger: User on a new device opens the app and enters a 6-character invite code on JoinFamily screen

steps.description: DeviceGate checks device_claims table — no row for this device_id. Family exists. DeviceGate sets screen='join'. Renders <JoinFamily />.
User types 6-char code. JoinFamily calls claimDevice(code).
claimDevice() fetches the join_codes row. Validates: row exists, used_at is null, expires_at has not passed.
Marks join code as used (sets used_at = now). Upserts device_claims row: device_id → family_id + member_id.
Returns { familyId, memberId }. JoinFamily passes claim to DeviceGate via onClaimed(). DeviceGate writes claim to localStorage and sets screen='ready'.
PinAuth renders. For a child device: device claim has memberId, so that member is auto-selected.

edge_cases: Code not found: claimDevice() throws 'Invalid code'
Code already used: throws 'Code already used'
Code expired (10-min TTL): throws 'Code expired'
Parent bypass link: skips code entry, creates claim with member_id=null, sees all members on PinAuth
failure_points: Device_id UUID not yet in localStorage: getOrCreateDeviceId() creates it on first call

flows.name: Parent generates invite code for a child
flows.trigger: Parent opens More → Invite Code, selects a member, taps 'Generate'

steps.description: InviteCode view renders. Parent selects a member from the list.
Parent taps Generate. generateJoinCode(familyId, memberId) called. Creates a random 6-char alphanumeric code (Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8).toUpperCase()). Sets expires_at = now + 10 minutes.
Code and expiresAt returned. InviteCode displays the code in large format with a live countdown bar. Parent reads code to child verbally or shares it.

edge_cases: Code collision (two codes identical): Supabase primary key constraint would throw. Extremely unlikely but possible.
failure_points: Code is only 6 chars — small entropy space, but 10-min TTL + single-use mitigates brute-force risk

flows.name: Child marks a mandatory chore done
flows.trigger: Child taps 'Done' button on a mandatory chore in the Chores screen

steps.description: Chores screen loads. getDueChoresForMember() filters allChores by isActive, type='mandatory', assignedTo includes memberId, and isDueToday(recurrence).
getChoreLogsForDate(memberId, today()) fetches today's existing logs. buildLogMap() creates a choreId→log lookup.
Child taps 'Done'. handleMark(chore) calls addChoreLog({ choreId, memberId, date }). Inserts a new chore_logs row with status='pending'.
loadLogs() re-fetches today's logs. MandatoryRow now shows Clock icon + 'waiting' status. Done button disappears.
Supabase Realtime fires 'chore_logs' change. FamilyContext.loadFamily() runs. reloadCount increments. ParentShell re-queries pending logs. Parent Approve tab badge increments.

edge_cases: Chore already has a pending log: Done button is hidden (canMark = false when status is pending or approved)
Rejected log: Done button reappears (canMark = true for rejected status), child can re-submit
failure_points: No guard against submitting twice before first insert completes — marking state prevents UI double-tap but not race conditions

flows.name: Child claims a bonus chore
flows.trigger: Child taps 'Claim' on a bonus chore in the Chores screen

steps.description: getAvailableBonusChores() returns all active bonus chores assigned to this member (or with empty assignedTo). Bonus chores are always visible regardless of recurrence.
Child taps Claim. handleClaim(chore) calls addChoreLog(). Inserts chore_logs row with status='pending'.
BonusRow updates to show 'Submitted' state. Parent sees it in the Approve queue.
When parent approves: approveBonusChoreLog() sets status='approved'. Bonus earnings are NOT credited immediately — they are collected during runPayslip() at payslip time.

edge_cases: Bonus chore approved after period ends but before payslip runs: included in the payslip for that period as long as the log date falls within the period dates
failure_points: Bonus earnings silently ignored if chore_logs aren't fetched for the correct date range in runPayslip

flows.name: Parent approves a chore log
flows.trigger: Parent taps the green checkmark on a pending chore log in the Approve screen

steps.description: ApproveChores loads. getPendingLogsForMembers(childIds), getPendingRewardRequests(childIds), getPendingMemberRequests(childIds) fetched in parallel.
Parent taps approve. approveChore(log) called. For mandatory chores: approveChoreLog(log.id) updates status='approved', approved_at=now in chore_logs.
updateCreditScore(memberId, +2) called (fire-and-forget). Fetches member, increments credit_score by 2 (clamped to 300–850), writes back.
Log removed from local state. Realtime fires. FamilyContext reloads. Child Chores screen updates to show CheckCircle.

edge_cases: Credit score update fails silently (fire-and-forget catch): chore is still approved, only score update is lost
Approve All: loops through logs sequentially, each awaits the previous
failure_points: No transaction wrapping: if approveChoreLog succeeds but updateCreditScore fails, chore is approved but score not updated

flows.name: Parent rejects a chore log
flows.trigger: Parent taps the red X on a pending chore log in the Approve screen

steps.description: rejectChore(log) called. rejectChoreLog(log.id) updates status='rejected' in chore_logs.
updateCreditScore(memberId, -5) called. Child loses 5 credit points.
Log removed from UI queue. Child Chores screen shows XCircle + 'rejected — try again'. Done button reappears, child can re-submit.

flows.name: Parent runs a payslip (creates draft)
flows.trigger: Parent taps 'Run Payslip' button on a child card in the Dashboard on or after payday

steps.description: runPayslip(memberId) called from Dashboard. Fetches family config to determine period dates.
Parallel fetch: getMember(), getChores(), getChoreLogsForPeriod(periodStart, periodEnd), getUtilityCharges(periodStart, periodEnd), getChoreLogsForPeriod(daysAgo(60), periodEnd) for streak.
Guard: getPayslipForPeriod() checks if a payslip already exists for this period_end. Throws if one exists.
getLatestPayslip() fetches the previous settled payslip to get openingSavings and openingSubGoals for interest calculation.
calculateStreak(streakLogs, mandatoryChores) run. Counts consecutive days going back from yesterday where all due mandatory chores were approved.

calculatePayslip() called (pure, no DB). Computes: chore completion %, adjustedSalary, streakBonus, bonusChoreEarnings, gross, tax, rent, utilities, net, savingsAlloc, philanthropyAlloc, spending, loanInterest, loanRepayment, interest on savings+subGoals, new balances, missedMandatoryCount, bonusPotential.
addPayslip() saves the result as a new row with status='draft'. Member accounts NOT modified at this point.
Realtime fires. Dashboard shows draft payslip card. Child sees amber 'draft' banner on Home and amber badge on Ledger tab.

edge_cases: Payslip already exists for this period: throws, Dashboard shows error toast
Vacation (paid): adjustedSalary = baseSalary, no chore effect, normal deductions
Vacation (unpaid): gross = 0, rent/utilities waived, interest still accrues
First payslip ever: openingSavings falls back to current balance
failure_points: Period boundary bug: if currentPeriodEnd() returns wrong date, payslip covers wrong chores
Streak logs fetched from 60 days ago — timezone offset could cause off-by-one

flows.name: Parent settles a payslip
flows.trigger: Parent taps 'Settle' on a draft payslip card in the Dashboard or Ledger

steps.description: settlePayslip(payslipId) called. Fetches payslip row and family row in parallel.
Guard: throws if payslip not found or already settled.
getMember() fetches fresh member data (not from cache).

updateMemberAccounts() writes the payslip's balancesAfter (spending, savings, philanthropy, subGoals, loan) to the member row. This is the critical balance update — overwrites the entire accounts JSON.
updateTaxFund() adds (salary tax + interest tax) to family.tax_fund_balance and appends a history entry.

addTransaction() called for each line item: salary, streak bonus, bonus chores (individual), tax, interest tax, rent, recurring utilities, ad-hoc utilities, savings interest, philanthropy allocation, loan interest, loan repayment/cleared. Sequential loop.

Credit score delta computed: +10 for 100% completion, -30 for <50%, -2×missed for 50-99%. Loan repayment: +5 on-time, +20 if fully cleared (handled separately in makeEarlyRepayment for manual; auto-repay logic is in calculatePayslip). updateCreditScore(delta) called.

updatePayslipStatus(payslipId, 'settled') and updatePayslipCreditScore(payslipId, settledScore) called in parallel. Writes settled credit score back to the payslip row for accurate historical charting.
Realtime fires. Dashboard refreshes. Child Home shows updated balances. Credit score updates.

edge_cases: Vacation (unpaid): chore-related credit changes skipped entirely. Rent/utilities not deducted.
Loan outstanding = 0: no loan lines logged
scoreDelta = 0: updateCreditScore not called
failure_points: Sequential transaction writes: if one addTransaction() fails mid-loop, balances are already updated but some transactions are missing
No DB transaction wrapping — partial settlement is possible on network error

flows.name: Child requests a reward
flows.trigger: Child taps a reward card, reviews the confirm sheet, taps 'Request'

steps.description: Rewards screen loads. rewards from FamilyContext (already loaded). getRewardRequests(memberId) fetches child's own request history to show pending counts per reward.
Child taps reward card. BuySheet shows: reward emoji/title/price, current spending balance, affordability check, 'parent must approve' notice.
Child taps Request. addRewardRequest({ memberId, rewardId, rewardTitle, amount }) inserts into reward_requests with status='pending'. Child's spending balance NOT deducted yet.
loadRequests() re-fetches requests. RewardCard shows amber 'N pending' badge. BuySheet closes.
Realtime fires reward_requests change. FamilyContext reloads. ParentShell re-queries pending counts. Parent Approve badge increments.

edge_cases: Cannot afford: Request button disabled, BuySheet still opens to show the gap
Multiple pending: child can submit same reward multiple times — pendingCountMap tracks count

flows.name: Parent approves a reward request
flows.trigger: Parent taps the green checkmark on a reward request in the Approve screen

steps.description: approveReward(req) called. Calls approveRewardRequest(requestId, memberId, amount).
approveRewardRequest() fetches fresh member data. Checks spending >= amount. Throws 'Insufficient balance' if not.
Updates reward_requests row to status='approved', resolved_at=now.
updateMemberAccounts() deducts amount from spending balance.
addTransaction() logs a 'reward' type transaction with negative amount.
Realtime fires. ChildShell polls getRewardRequests() on next reloadCount tick. Detects newly approved request not in seenRewardIds set. Shows green toast: '🎉 [Reward] approved!' for 4 seconds.

edge_cases: Insufficient balance: alert() shown to parent, request stays pending
Reward deleted from catalog: rewardTitle is stored as snapshot on the request row, so display still works
failure_points: updateMemberAccounts succeeds but addTransaction fails: balance deducted without a transaction log

flows.name: Parent buys reward directly for child (no request queue)
flows.trigger: Parent opens ChildDetail, taps 'Buy Reward', selects a reward, confirms

steps.description: BuyRewardScreen overlay opens. Shows category filter tabs and 2-column reward grid with wallet before/after preview.
Parent selects reward and confirms. parentBuyReward(memberId, rewardId, rewardTitle, amount) called directly.
parentBuyReward() fetches member, checks spending >= amount, deducts via updateMemberAccounts(), logs 'reward' transaction.
BuyRewardScreen closes. Realtime fires, balance updates on all devices.

edge_cases: Disabled state when insufficient funds: button shows 'Need ₹X more' and is non-interactive

flows.name: Child saves spending to savings account
flows.trigger: Child opens Wallet, taps 'Save', enters amount, confirms

steps.description: Wallet screen. Child taps Save button. parentDepositToSavings(memberId, amount) called (named 'parent' historically but callable from child wallet directly).
Checks spending >= amount. updateMemberAccounts() moves amount from spending to savings. Two addTransaction() calls: one debit from spending, one credit to savings.
Realtime fires. Child Home and Savings screen update balances.

flows.name: Child requests cash/bank withdrawal from spending
flows.trigger: Child opens Wallet, taps 'Cash / Bank out', fills form, confirms

steps.description: CashOutSheet opens. Child selects destination (Physical Cash or Bank Transfer), enters amount and optional note.
addMemberRequest({ type: 'cash_withdrawal', memberId, familyId, amount, metadata: { destination, note } }) inserts into member_requests. Balance NOT deducted.
Realtime fires. Parent Approve badge increments.
Parent approves: approveSpendingWithdrawal(requestId, memberId, amount, destination). Deducts from spending, logs withdrawal transaction, resolves request.

edge_cases: Parent denies: resolveMemberRequest(id, 'denied') called. Balance untouched.

flows.name: Child creates a sub-goal and deposits to it
flows.trigger: Child opens GoalJar, taps '+', fills in goal name and target, saves; then taps 'Deposit'

steps.description: NewGoalSheet: child enters name and target. onSave creates a { id: crypto.randomUUID(), name, target, balance: 0 } object.
updateMemberAccounts() appends the new goal to member.accounts.subGoals array and writes the whole accounts object.
Child taps Deposit on a goal. DepositSheet opens. Child enters amount (capped at spending balance and remaining goal space).
parentDepositToSubGoal(memberId, subGoalId, amount): deducts from spending, adds to goal.balance in accounts.subGoals array, logs deposit transaction.

edge_cases: Deposit capped at target-balance: cannot over-fund a sub-goal
Goal reached: 'Goal reached!' badge shown, no more deposit button
failure_points: updateMemberAccounts overwrites full accounts JSON — if subGoals array is assembled incorrectly, other goals could be lost

flows.name: Child donates from philanthropy
flows.trigger: Child opens GoalJar, taps 'Donate', enters charity name and amount, confirms

steps.description: Child fills in donation form. addMemberRequest({ type: 'donation', amount, description: charityName }) inserts into member_requests.
Parent opens Approve screen. Sees donation request under 'PHILANTHROPY REQUESTS' section. Philanthropy balance shown.

Parent approves: approveDonation(requestId, memberId, amount, charityName). performDonation() deducts from philanthropy balance via updateMemberAccounts(), logs 'withdrawal' transaction with 'Donation to [charity]' description.

edge_cases: Insufficient philanthropy balance: canAfford check in ApproveChores disables approve button
Parent can also donate directly via ChildDetail screen: parentDonate() — no request queue

flows.name: Parent gives a loan to a child
flows.trigger: Parent opens Dashboard, opens child sheet, taps 'Give Loan', fills form, confirms

steps.description: Parent enters loan amount, weekly repayment amount, and optional interest-free toggle.
giveLoan(memberId, amount, weeklyRepayment, interestFree) called. Fetches member, adds amount to spending, sets accounts.loan = { outstanding, weeklyRepayment, interestFree }.
addTransaction() logs 'loan_credit' with positive amount.

At each subsequent payslip: calculatePayslip() applies loan interest (unless interestFree), then deducts min(weeklyRepay, outstanding, spending) from spending and reduces outstanding. settlePayslip() writes updated loan balance and logs loan_interest + loan_repay transactions.

edge_cases: Existing loan: outstanding is added to (not replaced), weeklyRepayment takes max of existing and new
Spending insufficient to cover full repayment: repayment = min(weeklyRepay, outstanding, spending)

flows.name: Parent gives a one-off bonus to a child
flows.trigger: Parent opens Dashboard child sheet, taps 'Give Money', enters amount and reason

steps.description: giveBonus(memberId, amount, reason) called. Fetches member, adds amount to spending, logs 'parent_bonus' transaction.
Realtime fires. Child spending balance updates immediately.

flows.name: Early loan repayment
flows.trigger: Parent opens Loans screen for a child, enters an early repayment amount, confirms

steps.description: makeEarlyRepayment(memberId, amount) called. Validates loan exists and spending >= amount.
actual = min(amount, loan.outstanding, spending). updateMemberAccounts(): deducts from spending, reduces/clears loan. If fully cleared: loan = null.
addTransaction(): 'loan_repay' or 'loan_cleared' type. updateCreditScore(): +20 if cleared, +5 if partial.

flows.name: Child votes for a tax fund goal
flows.trigger: Child opens FamilyFund screen, fills in a goal description and amount, taps 'Submit Vote'

steps.description: addTaxGoalVote(memberId, familyId, description, amount) called. First cancels any existing pending vote from this member.
Inserts new member_requests row with type='tax_goal_vote', status='pending'.
Parent opens Approve screen (or TaxFund screen). Sees pending votes. approveTaxGoalVote(requestId, familyId, description, amount, currentConfig) called.
updateFamilyConfig() sets taxFundGoal and taxFundGoalLabel. Cancels all other pending votes from the family. Approves this request.

edge_cases: Only one vote per child active at a time: submitting a new vote cancels the previous one

flows.name: Parent updates economic controls
flows.trigger: Parent opens More → Economic Controls, changes settings, taps Save

steps.description: EconomicControls screen loads family config. Simple mode shows: tax, rent, auto-save. Advanced mode adds: utilities, interest rates, philanthropy, payday schedule, per-child overrides.
Parent edits values and taps Save. updateFamilyConfig(familyId, newConfig) writes the merged config object.
For per-child overrides: updateMemberConfig(memberId, overrideConfig) writes to members.config column.
Realtime fires. FamilyContext reloads. New config takes effect on next payslip run. usePeriod() hook re-derives period dates if payday schedule changed.

edge_cases: Simple mode save preserves advanced fields (merge, not replace)
Loan interest rate must be >= savings interest rate — validated in UI
failure_points: Saving in Simple mode: advanced fields must be preserved via merge or they'll be zeroed

flows.name: Parent puts a child on vacation
flows.trigger: Parent opens More → Vacation Mode, toggles a child's vacation status, selects paid/unpaid

steps.description: Vacation screen shows per-child cards with ON/OFF toggle and paid/unpaid radio.
setMemberVacation(memberId, { active, paidLeave, startDate }) called. Merges vacation field into member.config and writes via updateMemberConfig().
Realtime fires. Child Home shows blue vacation banner. Chores screen shows slim vacation notice. Next payslip uses vacation flags from member.config.
At payslip time: calculatePayslip() reads member.config.vacation. Paid leave: full salary, no chore effect. Unpaid: gross=0, rent/utilities waived. Credit score changes for chores are skipped.

flows.name: Parent adds a new child member
flows.trigger: Parent opens More → Members, taps '+ Child', fills form, saves

steps.description: MemberSheet renders for isNew=true, isParent=false. Fields: name, avatar picker, salary, goal jar (optional), PIN.
hashPin(rawPin) called. addMember({ familyId, role:'child', name, avatar, pin, baseSalary, accounts: { spending:0, savings:0, goalJar }, creditScore:500 }) inserts into members.
reload() called. FamilyContext re-fetches members. New child appears in Dashboard and PIN auth grid.

edge_cases: PIN must be exactly 4 digits — validated before submit
Goal jar is optional: if omitted, goalJar = null in accounts

flows.name: Parent edits a member
flows.trigger: Parent opens Members screen, taps the pencil icon on a member card

steps.description: MemberSheet opens pre-filled with current values. Parent can change name, avatar, salary (children), PIN, goal jar.
updateMember(id, changes) called with only changed fields. Handles camelCase→snake_case mapping internally.
If PIN changed: hashPin() called first, new hash stored.

edge_cases: Salary change takes effect at next payslip (baseSalary read fresh at runPayslip time)
Goal jar edit preserves existing balance (only name/target updated)

flows.name: Parent logs a utility charge
flows.trigger: Parent opens More → Utilities, enters a charge for one or more children, taps Save

steps.description: UtilityLogger shows children list with amount inputs. Parent enters per-child amounts and a reason.
addUtilityCharge({ memberId, date: today(), reason, amount }) called for each child with a non-zero amount.
At next payslip: getUtilityCharges(memberId, periodStart, periodEnd) fetches these rows. calculatePayslip() includes them as individual deduction line items in payslip.deductions.utilities.

flows.name: Parent manages chores (create/edit/delete)
flows.trigger: Parent opens Chores tab, taps 'Mandatory' or 'Bonus ⚡' to add, or taps a chore to edit

steps.description: ChoreManager renders child-first tab layout. All/per-child tabs. EarningsSummary card shows base salary and completion count. ChoreForm bottom sheet opens for create or edit.
Create: addChore({ familyId, title, type, recurrence, daysPerWeek, value, assignedTo, isActive:true }) inserts into chores.
Edit: updateChore(id, changes) writes only changed fields.
Delete (soft): toggleChoreActive(id, true) sets is_active=false. Chore disappears from child view but chore_logs remain intact.

edge_cases: defaultAssigned prop: when creating from a child's tab, that child is pre-assigned
Custom recurrence: daysPerWeek field used for frequency calculation in payslip engine

flows.name: Parent exports all data
flows.trigger: Parent opens More → Backup, taps 'Export JSON'

steps.description: exportAllData(familyId) called. Nine parallel Supabase queries fetch all rows from families, members, chores, chore_logs, transactions, rewards, payslips, utility_charges, reward_requests.
Result mapped through row mappers. JSON.stringify'd and offered as a download via a temporary <a> element with data URL.

failure_points: Large datasets may hit browser memory limits for data URL approach

flows.name: Parent imports (restores) data from backup
flows.trigger: Parent opens Backup, selects a JSON file, confirms the destructive restore dialog

steps.description: Parent picks a .json file. FileReader reads it. JSON.parse'd. importAllData(data) called.

Delete phase: chore_logs, transactions, payslips, utility_charges, reward_requests deleted by member_id. Then chores, rewards deleted by family_id. Then members, families deleted. Order matters for FK-like dependencies.
Re-insert phase: families, members, chores, rewards, chore_logs, transactions, payslips, utility_charges, reward_requests inserted in order.
FamilyContext reloads. App reflects restored state.

edge_cases: No confirmation after file selection: destructive operation fires immediately on selection
failure_points: Malformed JSON: JSON.parse throws, caught by try/catch
Network failure mid-restore: partial wipe with partial re-insert, DB in inconsistent state
Schema version mismatch: payslip timestamps use msToISO conversion to handle older backups

flows.name: Reset all history and wallets (dev tool)
flows.trigger: Parent opens Backup, taps 'Reset All History & Wallets', confirms the two-step confirmation

steps.description: Two-step confirm: first tap shows red warning. Second tap fires the reset.
Parallel deletes: chore_logs, transactions, payslips, utility_charges, reward_requests, member_requests (all by member_id).
All children: updateMemberAccounts() zeros spending, savings, philanthropy, zeros subGoal balances. updateCreditScore() resets to 500.
updateTaxFund(FAMILY_ID, 0, []) zeros the tax fund balance and history.

failure_points: Non-transactional: parallel deletes may partially succeed if network drops mid-way

flows.name: Realtime data sync across devices
flows.trigger: Any write operation on a watched Supabase table from any device

steps.description: FamilyContext subscribes to 7 Supabase Realtime channels on mount: families, members, chores, rewards, chore_logs, payslips, reward_requests. Any INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on these tables fires the callback.
loadFamily() runs. Re-fetches all 4 datasets (family, members, chores, rewards). Increments reloadCount.
All views subscribed to reloadCount via useFamily() automatically re-render with fresh data.
ChildShell (Tier2Shell) also calls refreshMember() and checkDraft() on each reloadCount tick, and polls getRewardRequests() to detect newly approved rewards for toast notification.

edge_cases: Realtime connection drops silently: data goes stale. No auto-reconnect logic beyond Supabase client defaults.
Rapid changes: loadFamily() may fire multiple times in quick succession — all fetches are identical idempotent reads
failure_points: Supabase free tier: Realtime may have connection limits
Tables without Replication enabled won't fire Realtime events — verify in Supabase dashboard

flows.name: Credit score full lifecycle
flows.trigger: Various chore and payslip events throughout the week

steps.description: Initial score: 500 when member created. Range: 300–850 (clamped at every update).
Chore approved: +2. Chore rejected: -5. Both immediate (fire-and-forget) via updateCreditScore().
Payslip settled: +10 for 100% completion, -30 for <50%, -2×missed for 50-99%. Vacation: no change. Loan fully cleared: +20 bonus at early repayment; +5 for on-time scheduled repayment.
Post-settlement score written back to the payslip row via updatePayslipCreditScore(). This is what the historical chart reads — not the member.credit_score which reflects the live value.
CreditScorePopup shown once per period when the score changes. markCreditPopupSeen() writes periodEnd to member.last_credit_popup_period to suppress repeat.

edge_cases: Pending chore logs count as 'done' for credit purposes — parent approval delay doesn't penalise child
Credit popup suppressed until next period once seen
failure_points: If updateCreditScore (delta) and updatePayslipCreditScore (absolute) disagree, live score and historical chart diverge

flows.name: Parent dashboard renders child cards and detects overdue drafts
flows.trigger: Parent navigates to the Dashboard (default route after login)

steps.description: Dashboard mounts. children from FamilyContext (already loaded). For each child: today's chore logs fetched via getChoreLogsForDate().
getOverdueDrafts(childIds, currentPeriodEnd) fetches payslips with status='draft' and period_end < today. Shows amber banner for each overdue draft.
For children: getPayslipForPeriod() checks current period. If no payslip and today is payday (or autoPayslip=true): Run Payslip button shown.
Child cards rendered: avatar, name, credit score chip (coloured by band), spending/savings balances, today's chore progress bar (approved/due count).

edge_cases: isPayday() checks paydayDow (weekly) or paydayDom (monthly, clamped to last day of month)
autoPayslip = true: runPayslip() fires automatically on mount if today is payday and no payslip exists
